Coram : S.H. KAPADIA*, B. SUDERSHAN REDDY
Uttar Pradesh Trade Tax Act, 1948: s.3F - Transaction of transfer of right to use - Supply of plant and machinery on c lease - Receipt of lease rent - Taxability of - Held, on facts, taxable in terms of s.3-F as it was local sale. Assessee was engaged in the business of leasing and financing the case for the assessment year 1994-95, 1995-96 and 1996- D 97, the Department noticed that assessee supplied plant and machinery to KE Ltd, U.P. on lease and in return received lease rent.
